newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Banerj bank to be sold June 20 - official.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Banerj bank to be sold June 20 - official.

text.p: Brazilian state bank Banerj will be sold on June 20 for a minimum price of 300 million reais, said Rio de Janeiro state Planning Secretary Marco Aurelio Alencar.
Alencar also said the tender documents for Banerj's sale are due to be approved by the state's privatization committee May 28 and will be published on June 2.
He said new bidders could prequalify for the selloff as of May 28. Already prequalified investors -- Bradesco and Banco Itau -- do not have to prequalify again.

Alencar said the state has cut the bank's base price, previously set at 480 million reais, to 300 million reais because a number of non-operational assets were taken out of the bank and will not be offered to investors.
Also under Banerj's new selloff rules, bidders will be allowed to pay for 100 percent of the bank's sale price with privatization bonds.
The auction price will have to be paid by June 25 because the Central Bank special administration of Banerj expires June 26.
Alencar said Rio de Janeiro state is assuming all the bank's debt to its pension fund, which will be covered with a 2.9 billion reais loan by federal mortgage bank Caixa Economica Federal (CEF).
However, the contract with CEF still has to be approved by the Senate and the Rio de Janeiro Legislative Assembly.
"I am hopeful that the Senate and the assembly will approve the contract. Other contracts have been approved in less than a week," Alencar said.
Rio state attempted to privatize Banerj twice last year, but the auctions had to be called off because of court orders against the bank's sale.

Light investor interest was also seen as an obstacle to Banerj's selloff because some investors considered the bank's previous base price too high. ((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom 5521 5074151))
